title: Fucoxanthin Attenuates Inflammation via Interferon Regulatory Factor 3 (IRF3) to Improve Sepsis.
authors: Su, Jingqian; Guan, Biyun; Chen, Kunsen; Feng, Zhihua; Guo, Kai; Wang, Xue; Xiao, Jianbin; Chen, Siyuan; Chen, Wenzhi; Chen, Long; Chen, Qi
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 研究褐藻岩藻黄质靶向IRF3抑制炎症改善脓毒症，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Suppression of excessive inflammatory responses improves the survival of patients with sepsis. We previously illustrated the anti-inflammatory effects of fucoxanthin (FX), a natural carotenoid isolated from brown algae; nevertheless, the underlying mechanism remains unknown. In this study, we examine the mechanism of the action of FX by targeting interferon regulatory factor 3 (IRF3) to inhibit inflammatory response. We observed that FX regulated innate immunity by inhibiting IRF3 phosphorylation in vitro. The in silico approach demonstrated a good binding mode between FX and IRF3. To examine the in vivo effects of FX, a mouse model of sepsis induced by cecal ligation and puncture (CLP) was created using both wild-type (WT) and Irf3(-/-) mice. FX significantly reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine levels and reactive oxygen species production, changed the circulating immune cell composition, and increased the survival rate of the CLP-induced sepsis model. Overall, FX ameliorated sepsis by targeting IRF3 activation, providing novel insights into the therapeutic potential and molecular mechanism of action of FX in the treatment of sepsis and suggesting that it may be used clinically to improve the survival rate in mice undergoing sepsis.
abstract_zh: 抑制过度炎症反应可提高脓毒症患者的生存率。我们先前阐明了岩藻黄质（fucoxanthin, FX）——一种从褐藻中分离的天然类胡萝卜素——的抗炎作用；然而，其潜在机制仍不明确。在本研究中，我们通过靶向干扰素调节因子3（interferon regulatory factor 3, IRF3）来探讨FX的作用机制，以抑制炎症反应。我们观察到，FX在体外通过抑制IRF3磷酸化来调节先天免疫。计算机模拟方法显示FX与IRF3之间具有良好的结合模式。为研究FX的体内效应，我们使用野生型（wild-type, WT）和Irf3(-/-)小鼠建立了由盲肠结扎穿刺（cecal ligation and puncture, CLP）诱导的脓毒症小鼠模型。FX显著降低了促炎细胞因子水平和活性氧产生，改变了循环免疫细胞组成，并提高了CLP诱导脓毒症模型的生存率。总体而言，FX通过靶向IRF3激活来改善脓毒症，为FX在脓毒症治疗中的治疗潜力和分子作用机制提供了新见解，并提示其可能在临床上用于提高脓毒症小鼠的生存率。
